_comment: Proper-noun test for custom vocabulary (hotwords): sentences full of Taiwanese names, places, shops and brands that a family would add to 自訂詞彙. Spoken with Windows TTS by testdata/hotwords/generate_names.ps1 into datasets/hotwords_names (not in git). 'vocabulary' is what the user would type; it also has words that never occur, to catch false insertions.
